sections.title: Finishing the year
sections.content: Back in A1 you met the first four months. Here are the other eight, so you have the full year: május, június, július, augusztus, szeptember, október, november, december. Same rule as before for "in" a month: -ban or -ben by vowel harmony.

items.english: In October I work a lot.
In December I don't work, I just rest.

sections.content: You now know all twelve months — combined with hétfőn, kedden... from A1, you can already place almost anything in the calendar.
